title: Draft UI: Add fourth panel to main UI
description: Adds new UI layouts with 4 panels.

notes.body: I would be thankful for some help with the icons for the two new layouts. Currently there are only placeholders.

added 1 commit
  • c1e34cb5 - Draft UI: Add fourth panel to main UI
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10385/diffs?diff_id=659851057&start_sha=3af944df63bf586718c1a32d5c71674055ee1b51)
What do you think about this?

I think that if we should do any changes we should make the UI layouts more generic. It should be possible to configure any layout with all 4 panels. This must be properly stored and restored at startup and profile change.

@rknall was working on this a few years ago, but I don't know the state of his work.

I got as far as having a more generic solution to storing the layout information, but than the whole discussion with the dragable dialogs came in between. I would very much like to start that discussion again, as I agree, it should be possible to do this. 

But as @stigbjorlykke indicated, the current approach is not a good one, as it only increases the issue and does not provide a stable solution. I am all for working together with you @Developer-Alexander on an idea on how to implement this properly and what would needed to be done. First step would be to describe this in an issue and iron out the details of what needs to be adapted for it.

Then we should start an issue for that.

I would like to see 2 important uses cases supported:

IO Graph should be integrateable into the main UI (best case would be multiple instances): #18990 

An UI Plugin system to allw extension to extend the UI: #18959
As mentioned in !7638 it could be very cool to have multiple packet list views for different filters. (maybe as dockable tabs)

This could definatly be helpful.

Hoewever this is a task of considerable magnitude. I don't know what is the best way to go about this.
